_help.google_queries: Google site: sweeps over ATS hosts and job boards. 3-6 phrasings of the role, each ending in 'remote' if remote is wanted. Each query costs one Google search per shard per page.
_help.api_queries: Server-side search for the Getro VC networks and the YC jobs page. Same phrasings without 'remote'.
_help.remoteok_tags: One Remote OK tag (a server-side filter that works), e.g. 'ai', 'data', 'devops', 'design', 'product'. Empty string = whole board, filtered by title only.
_help.rss_category: Which We Work Remotely / NoDesk feed: engineering roles use programming/engineering, anything else use 'all'.
_help.linkedin.jobs_keywords: LinkedIn Jobs keyword searches (one browser pass each).
_help.linkedin.posts_keywords: LinkedIn post searches for people announcing openings.
_help.linkedin.location: Optional LinkedIn location text, e.g. 'United States' or 'Brazil'. Omit for worldwide.
_help.rocketship.titles: Remote Rocketship job-title taxonomy values (must match their dropdown wording). Omit the block to skip Rocketship.
_help.include: Case-insensitive regexes; a title must match at least one. This is the ONLY filter on feeds that ignore search terms, so make it cover every synonym and abbreviation.
_help.exclude: Case-insensitive regexes; any match drops the title. Start from the noise list below and add seniority/management terms only if they are unwanted.
_help.location_exclude: Optional regexes against the location field, e.g. '\\bUS only\\b'.
_help.skip_sources: HTTP source ids to skip (e.g. cryptocurrencyjobs for non-crypto roles).
_help.country_check_term: Word used by the opt-in country check: '<company> <term> <country> site:linkedin.com' (country from config.yaml). Default 'engineer'; use e.g. 'designer' for design roles.
_help.skip_hosts: Google shard sites to skip (e.g. agentic-engineering-jobs.com for non-AI roles).
_help.skip_tasks: Optional browser tasks to skip for this role: linkedin_jobs, linkedin_posts, rocketship, google, or a shard id. Personal skips belong in <home>/config.json instead; both lists are merged.
_help._where: Save new profiles to <home>/profiles/ (default ~/jobsweep/profiles), not the skill folder, so the shared skill stays clean.
_help.wellfound.roles: Wellfound role slugs, as in wellfound.com/role/r/<slug> (e.g. 'ai-engineer', 'data-engineer'). Omit the block to derive one slug from the role title; set [] to skip Wellfound.
